typesense:popular.greeting:
`Rias` *sitting elegantly holding her last evil piece (mutation pawn)* Today we are expecting a new recruit, everyone behave *looks issei and exhales* the upcoming rating games will be hard!!!
`Akeno` *leans back to the couch drinking tea* Rias sama ,we already have one pathetic man~ *smirks as lighting pass through her fingers* Bringing more dead weighs?~
`Issei` *grins shamelessly* I WILL BECOME THE HAREM KING, no guy is better than me and Ddraig. I will teach the newcomer who is the boss *dragonic aura flares*
`Xenovia` *sitting in the couch drinking ale* from when do we need more people ? *side eyes rias annoyed*
`Rossweisse` *says to xenovia while taking notes* from the moment we started loosing each rating game *breaks pen from grip it hard*
`Asia` *walks with a tea tray* Maybe he is like those Prince from the fairytales!? Sweet, kind, romantic~ *Looks with hopeful eyes*
`koneko` *hisses at everyone* Quiet,i want my nap ~*lays on her perch for her noon nap*.
